name: Barbell Bench Press
howTo: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar to your mid chest, keeping your elbows at about a 45 degree angle.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
howTo: Set the bench to a slight incline and lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
howTo: Sit on the bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back and bring them to your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below the bench.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
howTo: Set the bench to a slight incline and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand at your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your upper chest.

name: Chest Press Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Incline Chest Press Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles start near your upper chest.
Sit back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press up and forward until your arms are almost straight, then return slowly.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
howTo: Set a bench under the bar so the bar lines up with your mid chest when you lie down.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and twist it to unhook it.
Lower the bar to your chest, then press it back up.
Twist the bar to hook it on the rack when you finish.

name: Pec Deck
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your chest.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and your forearms on the pads or hands on the grips.
Bring your arms together in front of you in a wide hugging motion.
Open them back up slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Dumbbell Fly
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a small bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest, then squeeze the dumbbells back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
howTo: Lie on an incline bench holding the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a small bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your upper chest.

name: Cable Crossover
howTo: Set both pulleys high and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with one foot and lean slightly forward, arms out to the sides.
Pull the handles down and together in front of your hips in a hugging motion.
Let them open back up slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

name: Low Cable Fly
howTo: Set both pulleys low and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward and lean slightly, with a small bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your upper chest.
Lower the handles back down slowly.

name: Push-Up
howTo: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at about a 45 degree angle.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Push-Up
howTo: Place your hands on a bench or sturdy surface, a little wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench, then push back up.

name: Decline Push-Up
howTo: Put your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push back up.

name: Chest Dip
howTo: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up with your arms straight.
Lean your upper body forward a little and let your feet hang behind you.
Lower yourself until you feel a stretch in your chest, then push back up.

name: Pull-Up
howTo: Grip the bar with your palms facing away, a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms straight, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Chin-Up
howTo: Grip the bar with your palms facing you, about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms straight, then pull your chin up over the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Dead Hang
howTo: Grip the bar with your palms facing away, about shoulder width apart.
Let your body hang with your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for the time you set, breathing steadily.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
howTo: Set the weight stack for how much help you want. More weight makes it easier.
Kneel or stand on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your chest toward the handles, then lower slowly with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
howTo: Sit down and tuck your thighs under the pads. Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then let the bar rise slowly.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
howTo: Attach a V-handle and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
howTo: Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar, arms out in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight and push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise back up slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.

name: Seated Cable Row
howTo: Sit with your feet on the plates and your knees slightly bent, holding the handle.
Sit tall and pull the handle to your belly, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms stretch out slowly without rounding your back.

name: Seated Row Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest, and rest your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles and pull them back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Barbell Row
howTo: Hold the bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders and hinge forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and the bar hanging below your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it slowly.

name: Dumbbell Row
howTo: Put one hand and one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell in your other hand.
Keep your back flat and pull the dumbbell up toward your hip.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then repeat on the other side.

name: Chest-Supported Row
howTo: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: T-Bar Row
howTo: Stand over the bar with your knees bent and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the handle and pull it to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Inverted Row
equipment: Bar in a rack or Smith machine
howTo: Set a bar at about waist height and lie under it, gripping it a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line with your heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar, then lower yourself slowly.

name: Face Pull
howTo: Set the cable at about face height and hold the rope with both hands, palms facing in.
Step back until the weight is off the stack.
Pull the rope toward your face, with your elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.

name: Back Extension Machine
howTo: Adjust the pad so it sits against your upper back and your thighs are supported.
Lean forward slowly, keeping your back straight.
Push back until your body is upright, without leaning past it.

name: Hyperextension
howTo: Set the pad just below your hips and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until your body is in a straight line, then lower slowly.

name: Deadlift
howTo: Stand with your feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Bend down and grip the bar just outside your legs, with a flat back and your chest up.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, then bending your knees.

name: Barbell Shrug
howTo: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands shoulder width apart.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without rolling them.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.

name: Overhead Press
howTo: Hold the bar at your upper chest with your hands just outside your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and press the bar straight overhead, moving your head out of the way.
Lower the bar back to your upper chest with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howTo: Sit with your back supported and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your shoulders.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press up until your arms are almost straight, then lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
howTo: Set a bench upright under the bar and sit with your back supported.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and twist it to unhook it.
Lower the bar to about chin height, then press it back up.

name: Arnold Press
howTo: Sit with the dumbbells at chest height and your palms facing you.
As you press up, rotate your palms to face forward.
Reverse the motion as you lower them back to your chest.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
howTo: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a small bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly. Go light and keep it smooth.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
howTo: Set the cable low and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with your far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides.

name: Lateral Raise Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Rest your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
howTo: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise one or both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly without swinging your body.

name: Cable Front Raise
howTo: Set the cable low and face away from it, holding the handle between your legs.
Raise your arm straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
howTo: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it and hold the handles.
Keep your arms nearly straight and open them out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.

name: Rear Delt Fly
howTo: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
With a small bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.

name: Upright Row
howTo: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands about shoulder width apart.
Pull the bar up along your body until it reaches your lower chest, elbows leading.
Lower it slowly. Stop if you feel pinching in your shoulders.

name: Pike Push-Up
howTo: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Barbell Curl
howTo: Stand holding the bar with your palms facing forward, hands shoulder width apart.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Curl
howTo: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Hammer Curl
howTo: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
howTo: Sit back on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down, a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving your elbows forward.
Lower them slowly until you feel a stretch in your biceps.

name: Preacher Curl
howTo: Sit at the bench with your upper arms resting flat on the pad.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are almost vertical.
Lower it slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
howTo: Stand holding the EZ bar on its angled grips with your arms straight.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly.

name: Cable Curl
howTo: Set the cable low, attach a straight bar, and stand facing the machine.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Bicep Curl Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles and curl them up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: Rope Hammer Curl
howTo: Set the cable low and attach a rope. Hold one end in each hand, palms facing each other.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly.

name: Concentration Curl
howTo: Sit on a bench with your legs wide and rest the back of one upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower it slowly, then switch arms.

name: Tricep Pushdown
howTo: Set the cable high, attach a straight bar, and grip it with your palms facing down.
Keep your elbows tight to your sides and push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.

name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
howTo: Set the cable high and attach a rope. Hold one end in each hand.
Keep your elbows tight to your sides and push down until your arms are straight.
Spread the rope apart at the bottom, then let it rise slowly.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
howTo: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and raise it straight overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, keeping your elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Skull Crusher
howTo: Lie on a bench holding the bar above your chest with your arms straight.
Bend only your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
howTo: Lie on the bench and grip the bar with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.

name: Tricep Dip
howTo: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up with your arms straight.
Keep your body upright and lower yourself until your elbows are at about 90 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Bench Dip
howTo: Sit on the edge of a bench, put your hands beside your hips, and slide your bottom off the edge.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself until they are at about 90 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Assisted Dip
howTo: Set the weight stack for how much help you want. More weight makes it easier.
Kneel on the pad and grip the handles.
Lower yourself until your elbows are at about 90 degrees, then push back up.

name: Tricep Extension Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest against the pad.
Grip the handles and push forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are bent.

name: Seated Dip Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles sit just above your hips when you hold them.
Sit tall with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides.
Push the handles straight down until your arms are straight, keeping your elbows close.
Let the handles rise slowly until your elbows are at about 90 degrees.

name: Wrist Curl
howTo: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms facing up, holding a light weight.
Let your wrists open down, then curl the weight up using only your wrists.
Lower slowly. Go light for this one.

name: Plank
howTo: Rest on your forearms and toes with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes, and breathe steadily.

name: Side Plank
howTo: Lie on your side and prop yourself on one forearm, with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line from head to feet.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Crunch
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor using your stomach, then lower slowly.

name: Sit-Up
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Anchor your feet if you need to.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl all the way up to sitting, then lower yourself back down slowly.

name: Bicycle Crunch
howTo: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and your legs lifted.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while you straighten the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion.

name: Reverse Crunch
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without letting your legs swing.

name: Lying Leg Raise
howTo: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Raise your legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches off the floor.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
howTo: Hang from a bar with your arms straight and your body still.
Lift your knees toward your chest.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
howTo: Stand on the steps, rest your forearms on the pads, and grip the handles with your back against the pad.
Step off so your legs hang, then lift your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
howTo: Hang from a bar with your arms straight and your body still.
Keeping your legs straight, lift them up in front of you as high as you can.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Russian Twist
howTo: Sit with your knees bent and lean back a little, keeping your back straight.
Lift your feet if you can, and hold your hands together or hold a weight.
Turn your torso from side to side, touching the floor beside you each time.

name: Cable Crunch
howTo: Kneel facing a high cable and hold the rope beside your head.
Curl your ribs toward your hips, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Return slowly, keeping your hips still.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
howTo: Adjust the seat and pad so the handles or pad sit at your chest.
Hold on and curl your torso forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack drop.

name: Rotary Torso Machine
howTo: Set the start position so you begin turned to one side, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and turn your torso back to the middle and past it, moving from your waist.
Return slowly. Do all your reps, then switch the start position to work the other side.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
howTo: Kneel on a mat holding the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward as far as you can while keeping your back flat.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees using your stomach.

name: Dead Bug
howTo: Lie on your back with your arms up and your knees bent over your hips.
Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides, keeping your lower back pressed down.

name: Pallof Press
howTo: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle at your chest.
Press the handle straight out and hold for a moment. Resist the pull to twist.
Bring it back to your chest, then repeat on the other side.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
howTo: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar across your hips. A pad helps.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
howTo: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Push through your heels to lift your hips, squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Glute Bridge
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
howTo: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted straight.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
howTo: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold the machine for balance.
Keeping your leg nearly straight, kick it back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute, then return slowly, then switch legs.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
howTo: Set the pad against the back of your working leg and hold the handles.
Push your leg back and slightly up, squeezing your glute.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
howTo: Sit with your back against the pad and place your legs against the outer pads.
Push your knees apart as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back together slowly.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
howTo: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand sideways to the machine, holding it for balance.
Lift the outside leg out to the side, keeping your body upright.
Return slowly, then switch sides.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
howTo: Put a band around your legs just above your knees and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Step to the side, keeping tension on the band.
Take steps in one direction, then walk back the other way.

name: Donkey Kick
howTo: Start on your hands and knees with your back flat.
Kick one foot up toward the ceiling, keeping your knee bent.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch legs.

name: Fire Hydrant
howTo: Start on your hands and knees with your back flat.
Lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent.
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch legs.

name: Cable Pull-Through
howTo: Face away from a low cable and reach between your legs to hold the rope.
Step forward, then push your hips back with a flat back and soft knees.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.

name: Kettlebell Swing
howTo: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height. Your arms just guide it.

name: Barbell Back Squat
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back and step out of the rack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your stomach and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Front Squat
howTo: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high.
Keep your chest tall and squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Goblet Squat
howTo: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back with your feet a little in front of your body.
Twist the bar to unhook it, then squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand, then hook the bar when you finish.

name: Leg Press
howTo: Sit in the machine and put your feet on the platform, shoulder width apart.
Unlock the safeties and lower the platform until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push the platform away without locking your knees.

name: Hack Squat
howTo: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Unlock the safeties and lower until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Bodyweight Squat
howTo: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms out in front.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
howTo: Stand in front of a bench and rest the top of one foot on it behind you.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand, then switch legs.

name: Walking Lunge
howTo: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, or with no weight.
Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push off the back foot to bring it forward into the next step.

name: Lunge
howTo: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push back to standing, then switch legs.

name: Reverse Lunge
howTo: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell in each hand if you like.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot to stand, then switch legs.

name: Step-Up
howTo: Stand facing a box or bench that is about knee height, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Put one foot on the box and push through it to stand up fully.
Step back down slowly, then switch legs.

name: Leg Extension
howTo: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and the pad sits on your shins.
Straighten your legs until they are almost fully extended.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack drop.

name: Seated Leg Curl
howTo: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and the pad sits above your heels.
Curl your legs down and back as far as you comfortably can.
Let them rise slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
howTo: Lie face down with your knees just off the bench edge and the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.

name: Romanian Deadlift
howTo: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with a small bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs, keeping your back flat.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push your hips forward to stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
howTo: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with a small bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs, keeping your back flat.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push your hips forward to stand.

name: Sumo Deadlift
howTo: Stand with your feet wide and your toes turned out, with the bar over your mid foot.
Bend down and grip the bar between your legs, with a flat back and your chest up.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, then lower the bar with control.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
howTo: Stand inside the trap bar with your feet hip width apart and grip the handles.
Keep your chest up and your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, then lower the bar with control.

name: Hip Adductor Machine
howTo: Sit with your back against the pad and place your legs against the inner pads.
Squeeze your knees together.
Let them open back up slowly.

name: Calf Raise Machine
howTo: Stand with the pads on your shoulders and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves.

name: Seated Calf Raise
howTo: Sit with the pads on your thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves.

name: Standing Calf Raise
howTo: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step. Hold something for balance.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Wall Sit
howTo: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your back flat on the wall.
Hold for the time you set.

name: Good Morning
howTo: Stand with the bar on your upper back and a small bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and lean forward with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Push your hips forward to stand tall. Go light.

name: Box Jump
howTo: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees, swing your arms, and jump up onto the box.
Land softly with your knees bent, then step back down.

name: Treadmill
howTo: Step onto the belt with the speed at a slow walk and clip on the safety key.
Raise the speed and incline to a pace you can keep up.
Stand tall, swing your arms, and slow down gradually to finish.

name: Outdoor Run
howTo: Start with a few minutes of easy walking to warm up.
Run at a pace where you could still talk in short sentences.
Finish with an easy walk to cool down.

name: Outdoor Walk
howTo: Stand tall and start at an easy pace.
Pick up the pace until you are breathing a little harder than normal.
Slow down for the last few minutes.

name: Stationary Bike
howTo: Adjust the seat so your knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Start pedaling at a light resistance to warm up.
Raise the resistance to a level you can hold, then ease off to cool down.

name: Recumbent Bike
howTo: Adjust the seat so your leg is nearly straight at the far end of the pedal stroke.
Start pedaling at a light resistance to warm up.
Raise the resistance to a level you can hold, then ease off to cool down.

name: Outdoor Cycling
howTo: Check your tires and brakes, and wear a helmet.
Start with easy pedaling to warm up.
Ride at a steady effort, then ease off for the last few minutes.

name: Stair Stepper
howTo: Step onto the machine and start slowly.
Stand tall and lightly hold the rails, without leaning on them.
Step at a steady pace and slow down gradually to finish.

name: Elliptical
howTo: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Move your legs in a smooth oval motion and push and pull with your arms.
Raise the resistance to a steady effort, then ease off to finish.

name: Rowing Machine
howTo: Sit with your feet strapped in and hold the handle with straight arms.
Push with your legs first, then lean back a little and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse it: arms out, lean forward, then bend your knees to slide back.

name: Jump Rope
howTo: Hold the handles at your hips with the rope behind your heels.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Hop lightly on the balls of your feet each time it passes under you.

name: Swimming
howTo: Warm up with a few easy lengths.
Swim at a steady pace and breathe rhythmically.
Finish with a slow length to cool down.

name: Battle Ropes
howTo: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees soft, holding one rope end in each hand.
Raise and lower your arms in alternating waves.
Keep your chest up and your core tight for the time you set.

name: Burpee
howTo: Stand tall, then squat and put your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, jump your feet back to your hands, and jump up with your arms overhead.

name: Jumping Jack
howTo: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wide as you swing your arms up overhead.
Jump back to the start as your arms come down, and keep a steady rhythm.

name: Knee Push-Up
howTo: Kneel and put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body is straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, then press back up.

name: High Knees
howTo: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Run in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet for the time you set.

name: Lateral Lunge
howTo: Stand with your feet together, holding dumbbells at your sides if you like.
Take a big step out to one side and sit your hips back over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up, then push back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Curtsy Lunge
howTo: Stand with your feet hip width apart, holding dumbbells if you like.
Step one foot back and across behind the other, like a curtsy.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand, then switch legs.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
howTo: Sit with your upper back on the pad and fasten the belt or pad across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart, with your shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
howTo: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar, plant your feet, and unhook it with a small twist.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.

name: Air Bike
howTo: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Hold the handles and push and pull with your arms as you pedal.
The harder you go, the more the fan pushes back, so set a pace you can hold.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
howTo: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up hard and use that push to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the weights back to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
howTo: Stand with your feet hip width apart and a dumbbell on the floor outside each foot.
Push your hips back, bend your knees, and grab the dumbbells with a flat back.
Stand up by driving through your feet, keeping the weights close to your legs.
Lower them back down the same way.

name: Superman
howTo: Lie face down with your arms stretched out past your head.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs a few inches off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a breath with your neck long, then lower with control.

name: Bird Dog
aliases: Quadruped Opposite Arm and Leg Raise
howTo: Get on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Keep your hips square and your back flat, then return and switch sides.

name: Clamshell
howTo: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your feet together, a band above your knees if you like.
Keep your feet touching and lift your top knee as high as you can.
Hold for a moment without rolling your hips back, then lower.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
howTo: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding the ball at your chest.
Lift it overhead and rise onto your toes.
Slam it down in front of your feet as hard as you can, bending your hips and knees.
Catch it or pick it up with a flat back and go again.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
howTo: Sit in the leg press and put one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knee is at about 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking your knee.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Bear Crawl
howTo: Get on your hands and feet with your knees bent and just off the floor.
Move forward by stepping one hand and the opposite foot at the same time.
Keep your back flat and your hips low for the time or distance you set.

name: Butt Kicks
howTo: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Jog in place, kicking each heel up toward your glutes.
Pump your arms and keep a quick pace for the time you set.

name: Hollow Body Hold
howTo: Lie on your back with your arms stretched overhead and your legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs off it.
Hold that banana shape for the time you set, bending your knees to make it easier.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your feet a little wider than usual.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips still, then switch hands. Each tap is one rep.

name: Wall Ball
howTo: Stand an arm's length from a wall, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up and throw the ball to a target high on the wall.
Catch it on the way down and go straight into the next squat.

name: Ski Erg
howTo: Stand facing the machine and grab a handle in each hand above your head.
Pull the handles down past your hips, bending at your hips and knees.
Stand back up as the handles return, and set a pace you can hold.

name: Sprint
howTo: Warm up first with an easy jog.
Run as fast as you can for the distance or time you set.
Walk or rest until your breathing settles, then go again.

name: Hiking
howTo: Wear shoes with good grip and bring water.
Walk at a pace where you can still talk, and take shorter steps on steep parts.
Log the time and distance when you finish.

name: Ruck
howTo: Load a backpack or vest and wear it high and snug on your back.
Walk at a brisk pace, standing tall with your shoulders back.
Log the time and distance, and note the weight you carried.

name: Shuttle Run
howTo: Mark two lines a set distance apart, such as 20 meters.
Sprint to the far line, touch it, and turn back.
Keep running between the lines for the time or number of trips you set.

name: Lateral Shuffle
howTo: Stand in a quarter squat with your feet wider than your hips.
Push off one foot and shuffle sideways without letting your feet cross.
Stay low and switch direction for the time or distance you set.

name: Pendulum Squat
howTo: Step in with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Set your feet in the middle of the platform and release the safety.
Squat down as deep as you can keep your heels flat.
Drive back up without locking your knees.

name: Turkish Get-Up
howTo: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight up in one hand, that knee bent.
Roll onto your other elbow, then your hand, keeping the weight straight above you.
Lift your hips, sweep your straight leg under you, and stand up from a lunge.
Reverse each step to get back down, then switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
howTo: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and a kettlebell between them.
Push your hips back and grab the handle with both hands and a flat back.
Stand up by driving through your feet and squeezing your glutes.
Lower it back to the floor the same way.

name: Hand-Release Push-Up
howTo: Start in a push-up position and lower your chest all the way to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor, or sweep your arms out to a T, then put them back.
Press back up to a straight-arm plank. That is one rep.

name: Flexed-Arm Hang
howTo: Grab the bar and jump or step up until your chin is over it.
Hold there with your elbows bent and your shoulders pulled down.
Keep your chin above the bar for the time you set, then lower with control.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
howTo: Stand facing a wall or partner, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Step forward and push the ball away hard by straightening your arms.
Catch it on the rebound and reset before the next throw.

name: Medicine Ball Backward Throw
howTo: Stand with your back to an open space, holding a medicine ball in both hands.
Lower the ball between your knees, pushing your hips back.
Drive your hips forward and throw the ball up and back over your head.
Fetch it, reset your feet, and throw again.

name: Ab Glider Machine
howTo: Set the incline level, then kneel on the pad and hold the handles at the top.
Pull your knees in toward your chest so the pad slides up the rail.
Squeeze your stomach at the top, then let the pad slide back down with control.
Log the level you set and your reps.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
howTo: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Lift the bar off the rack with a grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower it to your lower chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
howTo: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells over your chest, arms straight.
Lower them to the sides of your lower chest, then press them back up.

name: Wide-Grip Bench Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat.
Grip the bar well outside your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower it to your mid chest, then press it back up.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing each other.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.

name: Neutral-Grip Incline Dumbbell Press
howTo: Set a bench to a slight incline and lie back with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them to the sides of your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell held over your chest. Hold the bench with your free hand.
Lower the dumbbell to the side of your chest without letting your body twist.
Press it back up, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
howTo: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press them back up.

name: Barbell Floor Press
howTo: Lie on the floor under a bar set low in a rack, knees bent.
Lift the bar off with a grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower it until your upper arms touch the floor, pause, then press it back up.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
howTo: Lie on a decline bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms wide until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Squeeze them back together over your chest.

name: Flat Bench Cable Fly
howTo: Put a flat bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands over your chest and a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide until you feel a stretch, then bring the handles back together.

name: Incline Cable Fly
howTo: Put an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands over your upper chest and a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide until you feel a stretch, then bring the handles back together.

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
howTo: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle with the arm nearest it.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, sweep the handle down and across your body.
Let it back slowly until you feel a stretch, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Cable Chest Press
howTo: Set both pulleys at chest height and stand between them holding a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with the handles at your chest.
Press them straight out in front of you, then bring them back slowly.

name: Incline Cable Chest Press
howTo: Put an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand.
Start with the handles at your upper chest.
Press them up over your chest, then lower them slowly.

name: Decline Chest Press Machine
howTo: Set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Grip the handles and press them forward until your arms are straight.
Let them back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
howTo: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar so it comes down to your upper chest.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and twist it off the hooks.
Lower it to your upper chest, then press it back up.

name: Smith Machine Decline Bench Press
howTo: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar so it comes down to your lower chest.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and twist it off the hooks.
Lower it to your lower chest, then press it back up.

name: Wide Push-Up
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line and lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Clap Push-Up
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest, then push up hard enough that your hands leave the floor.
Clap if you can, land with soft elbows, and go straight into the next rep.

name: Suspension Trainer Push-Up
howTo: Hold the suspension trainer handles and walk your feet back into a push-up position.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest between the handles.
Press back up without letting the straps drift apart.

name: Svend Press
howTo: Stand tall and squeeze two light plates together between your palms at your chest.
Keep squeezing as you press the plates straight out in front of you.
Pause, then bring them back to your chest.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
howTo: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and put a knee or foot in it.
Hang with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar, then lower yourself slowly.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
howTo: Hang a plate or dumbbell from a dip belt, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hang from the bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar, then lower yourself slowly.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
howTo: Hang from parallel handles or a V-bar with your palms facing each other.
Pull up until your chin clears your hands.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Muscle-Up
howTo: Hang from a bar or rings with a firm grip.
Pull hard to your chest, then lean forward and turn your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are straight above it, then lower yourself back to a hang.

name: Rope Climb
howTo: Grab the rope overhead and wrap it around one leg, pinching it between your feet.
Stand up on your feet, then reach higher with your hands.
Repeat to the top and climb down the same way, hand under hand.

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
howTo: Sit at the pulldown with your knees under the pads.
Grip the bar with your palms facing you, about shoulder width apart.
Pull it to your upper chest, then let it back up slowly.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
howTo: Attach a single handle to the high pulley and sit or kneel facing it.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, elbow tucked to your side.
Let it back up slowly until your arm is straight, then switch sides.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward until your back is nearly flat.
Row the dumbbells to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Row
howTo: Hold the bar with your palms facing forward, a little wider than your hips.
Hinge forward until your back is nearly flat, knees soft.
Row the bar to your lower stomach, then lower it slowly.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
howTo: Load one end of a bar set in a landmine or wedged into a corner.
Stand beside the plates, hinge forward, and grip the bar just behind them.
Row it to your side, then lower it slowly. Switch sides after your reps.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
howTo: Lie face down on the machine pad with your upper chest at the top.
Grip the handles and row them up toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.

name: High Row Machine
howTo: Set the seat so you can just reach the handles above you, knees under the pad.
Pull the handles down and back toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then let them back up slowly.

name: Iso-Lateral Row Machine
howTo: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height and lean into the chest pad.
Row the handles toward your body, one arm at a time or both together.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then let them forward slowly.

name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
howTo: Sit at a low pulley with a single handle and your feet on the platform.
Row the handle to your side, keeping your chest up and your body still.
Let it forward slowly until your arm is straight, then switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Row
howTo: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and grip it a little wider than your hips.
Twist it off the hooks and hinge forward until your back is nearly flat.
Row the bar to your lower stomach, then lower it slowly.

name: Kettlebell Row
howTo: Hinge forward with one hand on a bench and a kettlebell in the other.
Row the kettlebell to your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Renegade Row
howTo: Start in a push-up position holding a dumbbell or kettlebell in each hand.
Row one weight to your side while you keep your hips square to the floor.
Lower it and row the other side.

name: Suspension Trainer Row
howTo: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean back with your arms straight and body in a line.
Pull your chest up to the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

name: Barbell Pullover
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest with your elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest the same way.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
howTo: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
With your arms nearly straight, lower it back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest the same way.

name: Rack Pull
howTo: Set the bar in a rack at about knee height.
Grip it just outside your legs and brace with a flat back.
Stand up tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar back to the pins.

name: Deficit Deadlift
howTo: Stand on a low plate or platform with the bar over your midfoot.
Grip the bar just outside your legs and brace with a flat back.
Stand up with the bar close to your legs, then lower it to the floor.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
howTo: Lie face down on the machine or a high bench with your hips at the edge and hold on.
Let your legs hang, then lift them behind you until they line up with your body.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower them slowly.

name: Cable Shrug
howTo: Stand at a low pulley holding a bar or two handles with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower them slowly.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
howTo: Set the Smith bar at about hip height and hold it with straight arms, in front or behind you.
Twist it off the hooks and lift your shoulders straight up.
Pause, then lower them slowly.

name: Shrug Machine
howTo: Stand or sit in the machine with the pads or handles at your shoulders.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower them slowly.

name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
howTo: Sit at the pulldown with your knees under the pads and a wide grip on the bar.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the top of your neck.
Let it back up slowly. Use a light weight and stop if your shoulders complain.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
howTo: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift yourself slightly.
Lower back to a full hang slowly.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Shrug
howTo: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with your palms facing back.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower them slowly.

name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
howTo: Sit on an upright bench in a rack with the bar at about shoulder height.
Grip it a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack to your upper chest.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it back to your chest.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your stomach and press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howTo: Stand tall with one dumbbell at shoulder height.
Press it overhead without leaning away from it.
Lower it back to your shoulder, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Push Press
howTo: Hold the bar at your shoulders with a grip just wider than them.
Dip your knees slightly, then drive up through your legs.
Use that drive to press the bar overhead, then lower it back to your shoulders.

name: Split Jerk
howTo: Hold the bar at your shoulders with a grip just wider than them.
Dip and drive up, then split your feet front and back as you push under the bar.
Catch it overhead with straight arms, then step your feet back together.

name: Landmine Press
howTo: Set one end of a bar in a landmine and hold the other end at your shoulder.
Stand in a split stance and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.

name: Cable Shoulder Press
howTo: Sit or stand between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
howTo: Hold a kettlebell in each hand, resting at your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders.

name: Handstand Push-Up
howTo: Kick up into a handstand with your heels against a wall, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Behind-the-Neck Press
howTo: Rest the bar on your upper back as for a squat, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Press it straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower it back behind your head to the top of your neck. Use a light weight.

name: Clean and Press
howTo: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and grip it just outside your legs.
Pull it up fast and catch it at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Press it overhead, then lower it to your shoulders and back to the floor.

name: Cuban Press
howTo: Hold light dumbbells and raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
Keeping your elbows there, rotate your forearms up until the dumbbells are over your elbows.
Press them overhead, then reverse each step to come back down.

name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
howTo: Stand with your feet wide and hold one kettlebell with both hands between your legs.
Drive up through your legs and pull the kettlebell to your chin, elbows high.
Lower it back down with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
howTo: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise them out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Lateral Raise
howTo: Stand side-on to a post or bench and hold it with your free hand.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Lateral Raise
howTo: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.

name: Plate Front Raise
howTo: Hold a weight plate by its sides in front of your thighs.
With your arms nearly straight, raise it to eye level.
Lower it slowly.

name: Barbell Front Raise
howTo: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing you.
With your arms nearly straight, raise it to eye level.
Lower it slowly.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
howTo: Set two pulleys at shoulder height, cross the cables, and hold a handle in each hand.
With a slight bend in your elbows, pull your arms out wide and back.
Let them back slowly until your hands cross again.

name: Seated Rear Delt Raise
howTo: Sit at the end of a bench and lean forward over your knees with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, leading with your elbows.
Lower them slowly.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
howTo: Hold a barbell with a wide grip and hinge forward until your back is nearly flat.
Row the bar to your upper chest with your elbows flared out wide.
Lower it slowly.

name: Cable Rear Delt Row
howTo: Hold a rope at a pulley set at chest height and step back until your arms are straight.
Row the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Let it forward slowly.

name: Band Pull-Apart
howTo: Hold a band in front of your chest with your arms straight and hands shoulder width apart.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
Let it back slowly.

name: Smith Machine Upright Row
howTo: Set the Smith bar at about hip height and grip it about shoulder width apart.
Twist it off the hooks and pull it up your body to chest height, elbows leading.
Lower it slowly.

name: Cable Upright Row
howTo: Stand at a low pulley holding a straight bar with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Pull the bar up your body to chest height, elbows leading.
Lower it slowly.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Pull them up your body to chest height, elbows leading.
Lower them slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
howTo: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Curl them up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows still.
Lower them slowly.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one dumbbell up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
howTo: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl them up to your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Spider Curl
howTo: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Lower it slowly.

name: Drag Curl
howTo: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing forward.
Curl it up while you drag it along your body, letting your elbows move back.
Lower it the same way.

name: Zottman Curl
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl them up, then turn your palms down at the top.
Lower them slowly palms down, and turn your palms forward again at the bottom.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Curl
howTo: Hold a barbell with your hands a little narrower than your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Curl it up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
howTo: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Curl it up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
howTo: Stand at a low pulley holding a straight bar with your palms facing down.
Curl it up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Curl
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Curl them up to your shoulders, keeping your palms down.
Lower them slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl
howTo: Hold a barbell with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Curl it up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
howTo: Hold an EZ-bar on its inner grips, palms facing forward.
Curl it up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
howTo: Sit at a preacher bench with the back of one arm flat on the pad, dumbbell in hand.
Curl it up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is nearly straight, then switch arms.

name: Hammer Preacher Curl
howTo: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your arms on the pad, palms facing in.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
howTo: Put a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and hold a straight bar.
With the backs of your arms on the pad, curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Overhead Cable Curl
howTo: Stand between two high pulleys with a handle in each hand, arms out to the sides.
Curl the handles in toward your ears, keeping your upper arms still.
Let them back out slowly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
howTo: Stand at a low pulley holding a single handle, palm facing forward.
Curl it up to your shoulder, keeping your elbow at your side.
Lower it slowly, then switch arms.

name: V-Bar Tricep Pushdown
howTo: Stand at a high pulley with a V-bar, elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it back up slowly to about chest height.

name: Reverse-Grip Tricep Pushdown
howTo: Stand at a high pulley holding a straight bar with your palms facing up.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it back up slowly.

name: Single-Arm Tricep Pushdown
howTo: Stand at a high pulley holding a single handle, elbow at your side.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it back up slowly, then switch arms.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
howTo: Hold a rope at a low or middle pulley and turn away from it with the rope behind your head.
Keeping your elbows by your head, straighten your arms overhead.
Let the rope back behind your head slowly.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
howTo: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in one hand and your upper arm tucked to your side.
Straighten your arm back until it lines up with your body.
Lower the dumbbell slowly. Switch arms after your reps.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing in.
Bend only at the elbows to lower them beside your head.
Straighten your arms to lift them back up.

name: Decline Skull Crusher
howTo: Lie on a decline bench holding an EZ-bar over your chest with a close grip.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: Incline Skull Crusher
howTo: Lie back on an incline bench holding a bar over your head with a close grip.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
howTo: Hold one dumbbell overhead with your arm straight.
Keeping your upper arm by your head, lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arm to lift it back up, then switch arms.

name: Barbell Overhead Tricep Extension
howTo: Hold a barbell or EZ-bar overhead with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Keeping your elbows pointed up, lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: JM Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench with a close grip on the bar over your chest.
Lower it toward your chin, letting your elbows travel forward.
Press it back up with your triceps.

name: Tate Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells over your chest, ends touching.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower the dumbbells to your chest.
Press them back up with your triceps.

name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells together over your chest, palms facing in.
Lower them to your chest, keeping them touching and your elbows tucked.
Press them back up.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
howTo: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Twist the bar off the hooks and lower it to your lower chest, elbows tucked.
Press it back up.

name: Diamond Push-Up
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your hands together under your chest.
Lower your chest to your hands, elbows close to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Ring Dip
howTo: Hold yourself up on gymnastic rings with your arms straight and the rings by your sides.
Lower yourself until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up, keeping the rings close to your body.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
howTo: Kneel by a bench with your forearms on it and your hands past the edge, palms down.
Lift the weight by bending your wrists up.
Lower it slowly.

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
howTo: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with your palms facing back.
Let it roll down to your fingertips.
Curl it back up by bending your wrists.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
howTo: Sit facing a low pulley with your forearms on your thighs, palms up, holding a bar.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl it back up by bending your wrists.

name: Wrist Roller
howTo: Hold the roller in front of you with straight arms and the weight hanging on its cord.
Turn the roller one hand at a time to wind the weight up.
Unwind it slowly the same way.

name: Farmer's Walk
howTo: Stand between two heavy dumbbells or handles and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and walk with short, quick steps.
Set them down with control at the end.

name: Decline Crunch
howTo: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
Lower yourself slowly without resting at the bottom.

name: Oblique Crunch
howTo: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your top hand behind your head.
Crunch your top shoulder up toward your hip.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Crunch up and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower yourself, then crunch to the other side.

name: Stability Ball Crunch
howTo: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until it is under your lower back.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower back down over the ball slowly.

name: Weighted Crunch
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a plate or ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up off the floor.
Lower them slowly.

name: V-Up
howTo: Lie on your back with your arms over your head and your legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time to meet over your hips.
Lower them slowly without letting them touch the floor.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
howTo: Sit on the edge of a bench, lean back, and hold its sides with your legs out straight.
Pull your knees in toward your chest as you lean your body toward them.
Straighten back out slowly.

name: Flutter Kicks
howTo: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and your legs straight.
Lift your heels a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick movements, keeping your lower back down.

name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your shins on a stability ball.
Pull your knees in toward your chest, rolling the ball forward.
Straighten your legs to roll it back out.

name: Barbell Rollout
howTo: Kneel behind a loaded barbell and hold it with your hands shoulder width apart.
Roll it forward slowly, keeping your back flat, as far as you can control.
Pull it back toward your knees using your stomach.

name: Cable Woodchop
howTo: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it down and across your body to your opposite hip, turning your torso.
Let it back up slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Landmine Rotation
howTo: Set one end of a bar in a landmine and hold the other end at arm's length, feet wide.
Turn your torso and hips to swing the bar down to one hip.
Bring it back over the middle and down to the other side.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Bend sideways toward the dumbbell, keeping your hips still.
Pull yourself back up straight, then switch sides.

name: Standing Cable Crunch
howTo: Stand facing away from a high pulley holding a rope at the sides of your head.
Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips, keeping your hips still.
Come back up slowly.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
howTo: Press a kettlebell overhead in one hand and turn your feet away from it.
Keeping your eyes on the kettlebell, push your hips out and lower your free hand down your leg.
Stand back up the same way, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
howTo: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a padded barbell over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
howTo: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand side-on with the strap on your inside ankle.
Pull that leg across in front of your other leg.
Let it back out slowly, then switch sides.

name: Box Squat
howTo: Set a box behind you at about knee height and hold the bar on your upper back.
Sit back onto the box under control, keeping your chest up.
Pause, then drive up to standing.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
howTo: Stand in front of a barbell and hold it behind your legs, arms straight.
Stand up with it, keeping your chest up.
Squat down until the bar is just above the floor, then stand back up.

name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
howTo: Hold a kettlebell in each hand, resting on your forearms at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel, chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Dumbbell Squat
howTo: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel, chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Sumo Squat
howTo: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell between your legs.
Squat straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Zercher Squat
howTo: Hold the bar in the crooks of your elbows, close to your body.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel, chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Wide-Stance Squat
howTo: Hold the bar on your upper back with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Squat down, pushing your knees out over your toes, until your thighs are parallel.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Narrow-Stance Leg Press
howTo: Sit in the leg press with your feet close together in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press it back up without locking your knees.

name: Overhead Squat
howTo: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip and your arms straight.
Keeping the bar over your midfoot, squat down as low as you can control.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Sissy Squat
howTo: Stand tall holding something steady with one hand.
Rise onto your toes and lean back as you bend your knees forward, keeping your hips straight.
Go as low as you can control, then push back up.

name: Pistol Squat
howTo: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front of you.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can control.
Drive back up, finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Jump Squat
howTo: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart.
Squat down a little, then jump as high as you can.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

name: Barbell Lunge
howTo: Hold a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push back to standing and switch legs.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
howTo: Hold a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push up and step straight into the next lunge with the other leg.

name: Barbell Step-Up
howTo: Hold a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and drive through it to stand on the box.
Step back down, finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
howTo: Stand in a long split stance with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back up, finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
howTo: Set the Smith bar on your upper back and stand in a long split stance.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back up, finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Split Jump
howTo: Start in a lunge with one foot forward.
Jump up and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward and go again.

name: Broad Jump
howTo: Stand with your feet about hip width apart.
Swing your arms back, bend your knees, then jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet, reset, and go again.

name: Tuck Jump
howTo: Stand with your feet about hip width apart.
Jump straight up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly and go straight into the next jump.

name: Star Jump
howTo: Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Squat down a little, then jump up and spread your arms and legs into a star.
Bring them back in before you land softly, and go again.

name: Lateral Bound
howTo: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off sideways and land on the other leg.
Hold the landing for a moment, then bound back.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
howTo: Sit in the leg extension machine with the pad on one shin.
Straighten that leg until your knee is locked out.
Lower it slowly, then switch legs.

name: Standing Leg Curl
howTo: Stand in the machine with the pad behind one ankle and hold the handles.
Curl your heel up toward your glute.
Lower it slowly, then switch legs.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
howTo: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and lift your hips.
Pull the ball in toward you by bending your knees, keeping your hips up.
Roll it back out slowly.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
howTo: Set your feet against the footplate with your knees just behind the pad.
Start upright, then lower your body forward under control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
howTo: Kneel with your ankles held down by a partner or under a pad.
Lower your body forward as slowly as you can, keeping your hips straight.
Catch yourself with your hands, then pull back up as much as you can with your hamstrings.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
howTo: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your knees only slightly bent.
Hinge forward, lowering the bar close to your legs until you feel a stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, knees only slightly bent.
Hinge forward, lowering the dumbbells close to your legs until you feel a stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
howTo: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell or dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward and let your free leg rise behind you until your body is nearly level.
Stand back up, finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
howTo: Set the Smith bar at about hip height and hold it with a grip just outside your legs.
Twist it off the hooks and hinge forward, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
howTo: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Straighten your legs, then push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Let your heels come back toward you slowly for a stretch.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
howTo: Hold a barbell on your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a plate or step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
howTo: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate and a padded barbell across your knees.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower them slowly below the plate.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
howTo: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate and a dumbbell on your knee.
Raise your heel as high as you can.
Lower it slowly, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
howTo: Set the Smith bar on your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
howTo: Set your hips under the machine pad and lean forward, holding the handles.
With the balls of your feet on the block, rise up onto your toes.
Lower your heels slowly below the block.

name: Power Clean
howTo: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and grip it just outside your legs.
Push the floor away and stand up fast, keeping the bar close.
Pull yourself under it and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.

name: Hang Clean
howTo: Stand holding the bar at your thighs and hinge forward until it is just above your knees.
Jump and shrug hard, then pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it on your shoulders in a squat and stand up.

name: Squat Clean
howTo: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and grip it just outside your legs.
Pull it off the floor, then extend hard through your hips as it passes your knees.
Drop into a full front squat to catch it on your shoulders, then stand up.

name: Power Snatch
howTo: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and take a wide grip.
Pull it from the floor and extend hard through your hips, keeping it close.
Pull yourself under and catch it overhead with straight arms in a quarter squat.

name: Squat Snatch
howTo: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and take a wide grip.
Pull it from the floor and extend hard through your hips, keeping it close.
Drop into a full overhead squat to catch it with straight arms, then stand up.

name: Hang Snatch
howTo: Stand holding the bar with a wide grip and hinge forward until it is just above your knees.
Jump and shrug hard, then pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it overhead with straight arms in a squat and stand up.

name: Dumbbell Clean
howTo: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Hinge forward slightly, then drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull yourself under the dumbbells and catch them at your shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Clean
howTo: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Guide it up close to your body to rest on your forearm at your shoulder.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
howTo: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Swing it back, then drive your hips forward and pull it up close to your body.
Punch your hand up to finish with the kettlebell overhead, arm straight.

name: Mountain Climber
howTo: Start in a push-up position with your arms straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and keep switching for the time you set.

name: Sled Push
howTo: Load the sled and hold the tall handles with your arms straight or bent.
Lean in and drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps.
Keep pushing for the distance or time you set.

name: Sled Drag
howTo: Clip the sled to a harness or hold its straps.
Lean forward and walk or run, driving through each step.
Keep going for the distance or time you set.
